for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(':
        stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop()
        pair[i]=j
        pair[j]=i

def bp_dist_pairs(p1, p2):
    return sum(1 for i in range(n) if p1[i]!=p2[i])

def pairs_of(ss):
    p=[-1]*n
    st=[]
    for i,c in enumerate(ss):

    ss,mfe=fc.mfe()

    return bp_dist_pairs(pairs_of(ss), target_pairs), ss

def init_seq():
    s=['A']*n
    for i in range(n):
        if pair[i]>i:
            s[i]='G'; s[pair[i]]='C'
    return ''.join(s)

def run(seed, time_limit=140):
    random.seed(seed)
    cur=list(init_seq())
    cur_score, _ = score_seq(''.join(cur))
    best=cur[:]

    T=2.0
    t0=time.time()
